summary.text: John Fons is the Republican candidate for the Wisconsin State Assembly, District 79, in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing incumbent Democrat Lisa Subeck. He was also a candidate for Dane County Board of Supervisors District 7 in the April 7, 2026 election.

paragraphs.text: John Fons ran for the Dane County Board of Supervisors, District 7, and lost in the general election on April 7, 2026.
He advanced from the Republican primary for Wisconsin State Assembly District 79 on August 11, 2026.
